name: tugite
description: Use the explicit workflows how-it, explorer-this, visualize-that, impl-lead, plan-agent, find-way, and test-verify, plus review-refine, code-review, and test-report with internal skills, workers, reviewers, and advisors.

interface.longDescription: Codex skills for how-it, explorer-this, visualize-that, impl-lead, plan-agent, find-way, review-refine, code-review, test-report, and explicit-only test-verify, plus their internal skills, workers, reviewers, and advisors. Visualize That turns arbitrary supplied material into meaning-preserving visual HTML and reports capability-relative render verification. Find Way resolves Destination-wide pre-planning fog into self-contained Work Units without starting downstream work. Test-report presents full-scope behavior details and grounded static diagnosis through the shared Verification Topology, without execution or repair. Explicit-only Test-verify revalidates a report or direct bounded target, verifies and repairs authorized target-causal Problems, applies changed-test acceptance and Completion Gate to applicable changed snapshots, and performs final verification including no-change outcomes. Commit authority is separate from verification.
defaultPrompt: Use $how-it only for an explicit public workflow; use Interactive Model Construction to build how to proceed or make the request viable, keep one task-local Local Model, and connect directly to the requested output.

Use $explorer-this only for explicit public exploration requests; keep one task-local Local Model, use Agentic Model Construction first, locally confirm only material Human-owned facts, scope, or authority after a qualified stop, and connect the result directly to the requested output.

Use $visualize-that only when explicitly requested; turn arbitrary supplied material into meaning-preserving standalone visual HTML, then return verified or render-unverified according to available launch, capture, and actual inspection capability.

Use $test-report when explicitly requested or when the user clearly wants to understand a specified set of tests; report full-scope behavior details and grounded static findings separately from runtime hypotheses and unknowns, with selectable handoff, without editing or running tests.

Use $test-verify only when explicitly requested; revalidate a report or direct bounded target, verify from grounded runtime evidence, repair only authorized target-causal Problems, apply changed-test acceptance and Completion Gate when applicable, and run final verification. No-change needs no change review or empty commit; commit authority is separate from verification.

Use $plan-agent only when explicitly requested to create a recommendation-first free-form planning or design artifact from normal context without starting implementation; use review only when applicable and not opted out.

Use $find-way only when explicitly requested to resolve Destination-wide Planning Fog and Decision blockers into self-contained Work Units without starting planning, review, implementation, delivery, or downstream routing.
Use $review-refine to review and coherently refine a verified artifact snapshot, then return converged or incomplete with the latest verified candidate.

Use $code-review when explicitly requested or when the user clearly wants a Tugite code-review of a change set; capture an immutable snapshot, route specialist reviewers, and report evidence-checked findings without fixing, adjudicating, or writing to the review target. Do not start during impl-lead or plan-family public workflows.

Use $impl-lead only when explicitly requested to normalize implementation work into Implementation Units, then orchestrate implementation, Parent QA, acceptance, final verification, and safe integration.
Use $install-custom-agents to check, install, or update the bundled custom agents.
